The City of New York in partnership with GovDeals.com

posts vehicle and heavy machinery auctions online every week at:

https://www.govdeals.com/en/nyc-dcas-fleet

row.additional_description_1:
Notice of Medallion Sale Upset Price

The New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission wishes to announce that the minimum upset price for 32 Accessible Minifleet Medallions will be $850,000 per medallion. These Accessible Minifleet Medallions will be offered for sale in lots of two for a minimum bid of $1,700,000. The TLC will receive bids in person on March 19, 20, 21 and 24, 2014, from 9:00 A.M. through 12:00 Noon at its offices at 33 Beaver Street, 19th Floor, New York, NY 10004. Bid packages are available online at http://www.nyc.gov/taxi.
